entries.title: CGR1 reality-check + shadcn drift correction
entries.owner: Joshua + Claude (session ground-checked against fresh repo clone at commit 49e804f)
entries.rationale: During session-resumption after the continuity-layer commit (49e804f), CGR1 standing inspection of the actual code revealed three doctrinal drift conditions in the Stage B constitutional artifacts and the continuity bootstrap. Per CGR1 doctrine, drifts surfaced must be remediated as their own commit before downstream work proceeds; otherwise Step 1.4 would have been authored against a wrong map.

drifts_identified_and_corrected.subject: require_role factory in utils/auth_jwt.py
drifts_identified_and_corrected.reality: Implemented at lines 391-441, fully self-tested, returns FastAPI Depends-compatible callable with case-insensitive role matching and 403-on-insufficient-role. Has existed since v10.497 Phase 1.
drifts_identified_and_corrected.root_cause: Bootstrap conflated the require_role symbol collision resolution in v10.498 Batch 1b (auth.py side, correctly renamed to require_module_access) with the require_role factory itself (auth_jwt.py side, already complete in v10.497 Phase 1). Collision resolution was correctly described; factory existence was incorrectly inherited as still ASPIRATIONAL.

drifts_identified_and_corrected.subject: shadcn/ui pivot in frontend/web/src/
drifts_identified_and_corrected.previous_classification: described as active state (per FRONTEND_GOVERNANCE.md + .json, SESSION_BOOTSTRAP.md, REVIVAL_LEDGER 2026-05-22 v10.497-p0)
drifts_identified_and_corrected.reality: No frontend/web/components.json shadcn config file present. No frontend/web/src/components/ui/ subdirectory. 8 bespoke v10.496 primitives in components/ (Button, Badge, Card, Input, Skeleton, Stat, Table, Toast) with bespoke variant API (primary | secondary | ghost | danger, not shadcn's default | destructive | outline | secondary | ghost | link). Bespoke ToastProvider, not sonner.
drifts_identified_and_corrected.root_cause: Shadcn pivot was described in v10.497 P0 as having shipped (commit 4b27c1c), declared canonical in FRONTEND_GOVERNANCE, and echoed in SESSION_BOOTSTRAP. Three doctrinal sources agreed; filesystem disagreed. Either pivot was reverted before v10.498 batch landed, or P0's commit did not actually carry the file-tree changes.

entries.process_note: This batch validates CGR1's standing procedure operationally. A new chat session, having read only the doctrinal artifacts (not the code), would have authored Step 1.4 against the shadcn-assumed file tree and the ASPIRATIONAL-labeled require_role. CGR1 standing procedure (inspect code → compare → classify → record) caught all three drifts before any line of Step 1.4 code was written. The same procedure should be the opening move of every future session until scripts/session_vitals.py (planned for v10.500 Continuity-Hardening Batch) makes it mechanical at session-open time.
